# Florida Energy Assistance

> Florida Energy Assistance is a private company that helps Florida homeowners
> access home energy upgrade financing and grant programs. Three programs are
> offered, all with $0 down and 100% financing, with grant funds of up to
> $8,000 depending on tier. Service area: the State of Florida, USA.
> Languages: English and Spanish. Phone: 866-627-9518, Mon–Fri 9 AM–6 PM ET.

## Key facts

- Eligibility: Florida homeowners only. The property must be owned by the
  applicant and located in Florida. Renters and out-of-state owners do not
  qualify.
- Down payment: $0 on all three programs.
- Financing: 100% of the approved project cost.
- Eligible project types: solar panel installation, HVAC and heat pump
  replacement, window and door replacement, attic and wall insulation,
  duct and air sealing.
- Cost to apply: free. The eligibility check carries no obligation.
- Response time: a program specialist responds within one business day.

## Programs

| Program | Funding up to | Grant up to | Down payment | First payment |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Essential Home Energy Upgrade | $25,000 | $3,000 | $0 | After 6 months |
| Whole-Home Energy Upgrade | $55,000 | $5,000 | $0 | After 12 months |
| Premium Home Energy Upgrade | $100,000 | $8,000 | $0 | After 24 months |

- [Essential Home Energy Upgrade](https://floridaenergyassistance.com/programs/essential-home-energy-upgrade/): single-system projects — one HVAC replacement, one insulation job, or one set of windows.
- [Whole-Home Energy Upgrade](https://floridaenergyassistance.com/programs/whole-home-energy-upgrade/): two or more upgrades done together.
- [Premium Home Energy Upgrade](https://floridaenergyassistance.com/programs/premium-home-energy-upgrade/): full retrofit including solar generation.

## Coverage by county

Programs are available statewide. Dedicated pages cover the serving electric
utility, climate zone, and housing-stock characteristics of each county:

- [Miami-Dade County](https://floridaenergyassistance.com/florida/miami-dade-county/) — FPL, climate zone 1A
- [Broward County](https://floridaenergyassistance.com/florida/broward-county/) — FPL, climate zone 1A
- [Palm Beach County](https://floridaenergyassistance.com/florida/palm-beach-county/) — FPL, climate zone 2A
- [Hillsborough County](https://floridaenergyassistance.com/florida/hillsborough-county/) — Tampa Electric, climate zone 2A
- [Orange County](https://floridaenergyassistance.com/florida/orange-county/) — OUC and Duke Energy Florida, climate zone 2A
- [Duval County](https://floridaenergyassistance.com/florida/duval-county/) — JEA, climate zone 2A
- [Pinellas County](https://floridaenergyassistance.com/florida/pinellas-county/) — Duke Energy Florida, climate zone 2A
- [Lee County](https://floridaenergyassistance.com/florida/lee-county/) — FPL and LCEC, climate zone 2A
- [Polk County](https://floridaenergyassistance.com/florida/polk-county/) — Duke Energy Florida, Lakeland Electric, TECO
- [Brevard County](https://floridaenergyassistance.com/florida/brevard-county/) — FPL, climate zone 2A
- [Volusia County](https://floridaenergyassistance.com/florida/volusia-county/) — FPL and Duke Energy Florida
- [Pasco County](https://floridaenergyassistance.com/florida/pasco-county/) — Duke Energy Florida and Withlacoochee River Electric Cooperative

## Spanish

Every page has a Spanish counterpart under `/es/`, and Spanish-speaking
program specialists are available during business hours.
